svg.title: Reachability bound, animated
svg.desc: Synthetic (DSR-12), no evidence credit. Looping reachability bound at 110 km/h on a straight road under any LKA command the panda passes, played at half speed from 0 to 3 s. Top view: the amber band is where the car's body can be, growing from the lane centre; the dashed outline is the bound without the panda's ramp; the car follows the hard-over run inside the band. Plot: the same bound, the no-ramp bound, the hard-over run and the envelope of 62 sampled runs against time. Events: fault: from here any LKA command the panda passes at 0.00 s; hard-over run drifts 0.2 m: the driver's cue at 1.13 s; the hard-over run's body reaches the lane line at 1.76 s; the bound reaches the lane line: the body may touch it at 1.77 s; driver corrects; bound 3.27 m, hard-over 3.31 m at 2.64 s; loop ends at 3.00 s. The bound is exact for the linear model: no command the panda passes drives it further. The hard-over and the sampled runs come from the nonlinear plant, which may exceed it by the measured linearisation error (0.045 m); the hard-over run is the worst case. Without the panda's ramp it would be 5.17 m at 2.64 s. Straight road, one speed; the plant is a model, so this ranks risks and earns no credit (DQ-139). Car: Kenney Racing Pack (CC0).
